panel_width_2hp.source: src-a7-a5-front-panel-geometry variants.2hp.width; laser-cut width tolerance not sourced

panel_thickness.source: src-a7-a5-front-panel-geometry panel.thickness 2.0; cast-PMMA sheet tolerance not sourced ('confirm with fabricator')

panel_hole_radial_float.source: radial clearance of the panel hole around the thread major diameter: 6.2 mm hole for a 6.0 mm thread major diameter, as A5 used for its 6.0 mm barrel

jack_axis_height.source: fact-a7-pj-324m-axis-height: scaled 2.9-3.0 from the SOFNG front view; not dimensioned. Band +/-0.4 covers scaling error. Not a confirmed dimension.

jack_overall_height.source: fact-a7-pj-324m-overall-height (title H6.30); tolerance taken from the .X +/-0.20 block

jack_terminal_projection.source: fact-a7-pj-324m-terminal-projection; measured from the body seating plane, not added to the PCB thickness

jack_axis_to_edge_far.source: fact-a7-pj-324m-axis-to-far-edge: calculated 11.5 - 5.4, not printed; tolerance is the sum of the two .X +/-0.20 values

thread_major_diameter.source: fact-a7-pj-324m-thread M6x0.5 (nominal major diameter of an M6 thread)

thread_lead_in_loss.source: half a pitch lost to the thread start/chamfer at the barrel tip; not sourced

front_body_gap.source: jack body front face seated on the PMMA rear (or on a rear spacer, modelled as a separate option)

pcb_thickness_options.source: common rigid FR-4 thicknesses; +/-10% thickness tolerance assumed, supplier tolerance not retained

lead_protrusion_trimmed.source: lead length beyond the solder side after factory trimming (min used at the best corner, max at the worst); the assembler's trim capability is not sourced (Q6)

side_clearance_required.source: minimum gap from any behind-panel part to the panel-outline plane (adjacent module, insulation)

nut_edge_margin_required.source: nut must stay inside the panel outline on the front face; 0.3 preferred so it does not reach a neighbouring module

min_engagement_required.source: at least two full M6x0.5 pitches engaged in the worst case; full nut-thickness engagement preferred

rear_pocket_depth.source: optional local rear pocket in the PMMA at each jack (concealed hardware seat); depth tolerance assumed

front_washer_thickness.source: thin flat washer option; no exact washer selected

a5_optical_skin_front_z.source: src-a7-a5-mechanical-geometry optical.skin_z[0]; A5 reference only, R2 may change it

a5_jack_y.source: src-a7-a5-front-panel-geometry controls.jack_y (A5 positions; A7 may move them)
